4,875 likes, 39 comments - shreyygupta on July 27, 2025: "From student to space-holder 💧❄️
Today marks the completion of my Ice Bath Facilitation Training, and I couldn’t be more grounded, grateful, and ready.

Facilitating this powerful session reminded me just how much strength lives beneath the surface — in the breath, in the stillness, in surrender.

Endless gratitude to my coach and guiding light, @sonakshiaroraa , for creating this deeply transformative container through House of Light and Abundance. Your vision, energy, and belief made this journey unforgettable.

To every body that braved the cold and leaned into the edge — thank you. We rise together, one breath at a time.

#IceBathFacilitator #HouseOfLightAndAbundance #BreathBodyBravery #SomaticHealing #NervousSystemReset #ColdTherapy #EmotionalResilience #FacilitatorJourney".

posts.meta_description:
shreyygupta on September 3, 2026: "THE ASCENT — CHAMPIONS 🏔️

Twelve weeks. One climb. A hand-picked group who showed up every single day while everyone else was “starting Monday.”

No hacks. No shortcuts. Just the boring, brutal discipline of doing it again tomorrow. Here’s who rose:

🥇 Most Steps — @beinghumansandy 
1.3 million steps. Set the pace on day one and never gave it back.

🚀 Most Improved — @parthhssodhiii09 
Nearly tripled their daily steps in three months. Started at the back. Finished a different person entirely.

🔥 Most Consistent — @dhruvm_23 
Never the loudest number on the board — just there. Every. Single. Day. That’s the one that actually builds a life.

Getting featured here was part of the prize. You earned the spotlight — take it. 👏

This is what The Ascent does. Not a challenge you try. One you come out the other side of.

The next climb is coming. Most people will watch. A few will sign up. 👀

#TheAscent #Elevate".
